marketMood: Cautious optimism: Trump-Xi summit hope lifts futures and Chinese assets, but the Fed's first rate hike since 2023 and oil above $100 on the Iran war keep inflation and stagflation risks front of mind.

topStories.headline: US-China Trade Talks Begin in New York Ahead of Trump-Xi Summit
topStories.summary: Treasury Secretary Bessent and Vice Premier He Lifeng opened negotiations in New York covering tariffs, agriculture, energy, and AI ahead of President Xi's state visit to Washington on September 24.
topStories.marketImpact: Risk-on tone — SPY ↑, QQQ ↑; potential tariff cuts on ~$30B in goods; new punitive tariffs delayed until after summit

topStories.headline: Fed Raises Rates to 3.75%–4.00%, First Hike Since 2023; More Expected This Year
topStories.summary: The FOMC voted unanimously to raise the federal funds rate 25bps, citing persistent inflation above target driven by surging oil prices; 16 of 18 members project at least one more hike in 2026.
topStories.marketImpact: TLT ↓; Dow and S&P under pressure ↓; financial sector watch; Nasdaq tech showed relative resilience

topStories.headline: Consumer Sentiment Plunges to Near-Record Low 47.8; Year-Ahead Inflation Expectations Hit 4.6%
topStories.summary: The University of Michigan's preliminary September sentiment index dropped 7.5% month-on-month to 47.8 — the second-lowest reading on record — as surging fuel prices and the Iran war weighed on household confidence.
topStories.marketImpact: Consumer discretionary ↓; XRT watch; stagflation concerns complicate Fed's rate path

topStories.headline: Bank of Japan Raises Policy Rate to 31-Year High of 1.25%; Yen Falls on Dovish Tone
topStories.summary: The BOJ hiked 25bps to 1.25% in a 7-2 vote on September 18, but the yen weakened as Governor Ueda signalled no commitment to immediate further increases, pushing USD/JPY back above 157.
topStories.marketImpact: USD/JPY ↑ above 157 (yen ↓); JGB 10Y yield slipped; Nikkei 225 ↑ 1.38% to 65,019; EWJ watch

topStories.headline: HKMA Tracks Fed With First Rate Hike in Three Years; Property Sub-Index Drops 2.4%
topStories.summary: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority raised its base rate to 4.25% under its Linked Exchange Rate System, immediately dragging the Hang Seng property sub-gauge down 2.4% and threatening Hong Kong's nascent property recovery.
topStories.marketImpact: 0016.HK ↓, 0823.HK ↓; Hang Seng -0.4% to 24,604; property sector under pressure

topStories.headline: Iran War Keeps Oil Above $100 as Strait of Hormuz Traffic Collapses 95%
topStories.summary: US-Iran military strikes have effectively frozen Strait of Hormuz tanker traffic to just 5-12 ships per day from over 100, with combined disruptions affecting roughly 39% of global trade and keeping WTI above $100 per barrel.
topStories.marketImpact: WTI ~$102/bbl, Brent ~$107/bbl ↑; XOM ↑, CVX ↑; airlines DAL ↓; global inflation pressure

topStories.headline: US Delays New China Tariffs Until After Xi Summit; Agriculture and Energy Tariff Cuts Under Discussion
topStories.summary: Washington will hold off announcing new excess-capacity tariffs on China until after the September 24 summit, while both sides are discussing cuts on roughly $30 billion in goods including US agricultural and energy exports.
topStories.marketImpact: BABA ↑, 0700.HK ↑, 9988.HK ↑; Chinese ADRs and HK tech names rally on summit optimism

topStories.headline: Japan Q2 GDP Growth Slows to 0.3%, Missing 0.5% Forecast
topStories.summary: Japan's economy expanded just 0.3% in the April-June quarter, down from 0.5% in Q1 and below consensus, as weak consumer spending and global trade headwinds weighed on the third-straight quarter of expansion.
topStories.marketImpact: 7203.T cautious ↓; EWJ watch; weak growth complicates BOJ's rate-hike path ahead of Oct 29 meeting
